thought.text: Shims dir confirmed. Now install forego from Go, and verify the toolchain:

reasoning_content:
I need to set up the PATH with the mise shims directory so that all the Ruby and Node tools are properly accessible in each shell session, and I should verify that the bundle command is working correctly through the shims.

Now I'm going to install forego via Go, making sure the GOPATH is set up correctly so the compiled binary ends up in a location that's already in the PATH.

action.command: docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspaces/workspace; export GOPATH=$HOME/go; go install github.com/ddollar/forego@master 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "GO_INSTALL_EXIT=$?"; ls -la $HOME/go/bin/ 2>/dev/null; node -v; pnpm -v; ruby -v; bundle -v'

tool_call.name: terminal
